company_description: Vivendi SE operates in the content, media, and entertainment industries in Europe, North America, Asia Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. The company creates and publishes video games for various digital devices, including mobile, PC, and consoles; and engages in the recorded music, music publishing, music-based merchandise, and audio-visual content businesses. It also provides online sports betting services; and media and education content in the Spanish and Spanish speaking markets, as well as creates, develops, sells, produces, and distributes content. In addition, the company is involved in publishing, media, and travel retail; commercial television broadcasting; and television, audiovisual production, and internet activities. The company was founded in 1853 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

description.long_fr: Vivendi est un groupe de médias et de communication. Le groupe a scindé en décembre 2024 ses activités en quatre entités cotées : Canal+ (TV payante), Havas (communication), Louis Hachette Group (édition et travel retail) et Vivendi recentré (Gameloft, Vivendi Village, Prisma Media). Contrôlé majoritairement par le groupe Bolloré.
description.long_en: Vivendi is a media and communications group. The group spun off its activities in December 2024 into four listed entities: Canal+ (pay TV), Havas (communications), Louis Hachette Group (publishing and travel retail) and a refocused Vivendi (Gameloft, Vivendi Village, Prisma Media). Majority controlled by the Bolloré group.
description.long_de: Vivendi ist ein Medien- und Kommunikationskonzern. Im Dezember 2024 hat der Konzern seine Aktivitäten in vier börsennotierte Einheiten aufgeteilt: Canal+ (Pay-TV), Havas (Kommunikation), Louis Hachette Group (Verlag und Travel‑Retail) und das neu ausgerichtete Vivendi (Gameloft, Vivendi Village, Prisma Media). Mehrheitlich kontrolliert von der Bolloré‑Gruppe.
